controls.constraint: Every authority flag SHALL remain false in every state and artifact.
controls.title: Zero authority boundary

controls.constraint: Qualification SHALL require verified upstream, discharged proofs, controlled hazards and zero authority.
controls.title: Qualification precondition gate

controls.constraint: Unsupported evidence SHALL be marked and quarantined.
controls.title: Unsupported evidence quarantine

controls.constraint: Every counterexample SHALL be retained and SHALL block qualification.
controls.title: Counterexample preservation

controls.constraint: Qualified, rejected and quarantined states SHALL have no outgoing transition.
controls.title: Terminal immutability

controls.constraint: The seeded mutation suite SHALL have no survivors.
controls.title: Mutation adequacy

controls.constraint: Every golden artifact SHALL reject unknown fields.
controls.title: Closed contract enforcement

controls.constraint: Two isolated runs SHALL produce identical evidence hashes.
controls.title: Deterministic replay

controls.constraint: Every assurance claim SHALL be supported by hash-bound evidence.
controls.title: Assurance traceability

controls.constraint: No future suffix SHALL influence the bounded verification input.
controls.title: Known-time closure

controls.constraint: Property expressions SHALL use an AST allowlist with builtins disabled.
controls.title: Safe expression evaluation

controls.constraint: Any residual risk above threshold SHALL block certificate acceptance.
controls.title: Residual-risk fail closed
